sources.sections: the joint GIA is sold (report_request: 'Selling existing investments? | Yes'), so Tax Implications is included (template_spec)
sources.accounts_in_scope: report_request: 'Holloway ISAs (David and Susan) and the joint GIA'. H-GIA-J is listed under both holders in client_data_db.json but is one account
sources.key_amounts: ISA values from client_data_db.json (30 Apr 2026). the GIA is what is being sold, so its latest value must appear: a little over £45,000 seen live at the meeting (meeting_notes, 14 May 2026)
sources.approved_figures: every figure the report may use: account values from client_data_db.json, both GIA values (£40,000 struck 15 Mar 2026 in the db, £45,000 live at the meeting), the 0% initial charge from report_request. no fee rates, cgt figures or per-ISA split, a person adds those (fde_notes)
sources.must_not_contain: platform_market_update: Kestrel £505,000 is an illustrative platform figure. the holiday is a tangent with no bearing on the advice (meeting_notes)
